events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-09-05 Katie Taylor vs Flora Pili
events.strDescriptionEN: Katie Taylor returns to Dublin for a major championship showdown against Flora Pili at Croke Park. With Taylor defending her undisputed super-lightweight crown in front of a home crowd, the bout carries both sporting significance and a special sense of occasion. Pili will look to spoil the celebration, while Taylor aims to deliver another defining performance on one of the biggest stages of her career.
events.strResult: Katie Taylor brought her extraordinary career to a fitting close by dominating Flora Pili over ten rounds at Croke Park, winning a unanimous decision by scores of 100–90, 100–90 and 98–91. Fighting in front of a huge home crowd, Taylor controlled the contest with her speed, timing and experience to become a three-time undisputed world champion before confirming the end of her professional career with a record of 26 wins and one defeat.
